description: Everything CCPEDIA holds about ONE Canton Dev Fund proposal (a pull request in canton-foundation/canton-dev-fund), by its PR number: state and project-board column, labels, the facts parsed from the proposal file (organization, author, declared RFP, champion, funding in CC, duration, SIG label, milestones), champion evidence (board column, proposal file, PR text), reviewers, discussion statistics, and the timeline of label, reviewer, rename and board events. Use after get_proposals, list_proposals_needing_champion or search_dev_fund returned a number. For the full conversation use get_proposal_discussion, for the full proposal text get_proposal_file. Canton-specific.

number.description: PR (or issue) number in canton-foundation/canton-dev-fund, e.g. 439.

name: get_proposal
